[[3643 BBY]]''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' |series=[[Star Wars: The Old Republic (novel series)|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' novel series]] |preceded by=[[Red Harvest (novel)|''Red Harvest'']] |followed by=''[[The Price of Power]]'' }} '''''The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance''''' is a novel by [[Sean Williams]] released on [[July 20]], [[2010]], based on the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It was first mentioned on [[November 10]], [[2008]], when [[Sue Rostoni]] stated: "A novel will come out sometime around the game release time and that's all that's been determined so far."{{WebCite|url=http://www.theforce.net/latestnews/story/The_Old_Republic_Novelization_119002.asp|text=The Old Republic Novelization|date=2008-11-10|work=[[TheForce.net]]|archivedate=20190804001344}} A preview of the book was published in ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]''. The [[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance (audiobook)|audio version]] of the book is performed by [[Marc Thompson]].
